name: Afromimus
isnote: Named in 2017 as an ornithomimosaur (Sereno 2017), but Wikipedia calls it a ceratosaurian and Cerroni et al. 2019 re-examined its phylogenetic position; Theropoda is the deepest clade the analyses share here.
sum: Theropod from the Early Cretaceous Elrhaz Formation of Niger, whose group has been revised since its naming.
holotype: Not given in the sources used.
material: Not given in the sources used.
